events.description: Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani is currently hearing comments that Joey Tribbiani cannot believe.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay is currently hearing comments that Phoebe Buffay cannot believe.
Monica Geller tells Phoebe Buffay to stop currently repeating Monica Geller's words.
Phoebe Buffay asks whether Phoebe Buffay was just now repeating other people's words again.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller previously said that Joey Tribbiani has a nice butt.
Monica Geller says Joey Tribbiani's butt is not a great butt.
Joey Tribbiani says Monica Geller would not recognize a great butt.
Joey Tribbiani says a great butt could come up to Monica Geller and bite Monica Geller.
Ross Geller says the mental image of a great butt coming up and biting Monica Geller comes to mind.
Rachel Green asks whether anyone would like to have more coffee now.
Chandler Bing asks whether Rachel Green made the coffee earlier.
Chandler Bing asks whether Rachel Green is just serving the coffee now.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is just serving the coffee now.
Monica Geller, Phoebe Buffay, Joey Tribbiani, Ross Geller, and Chandler Bing say they will have a cup of coffee.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing is in Las Vegas in his dream scenario.
Rachel Green asks the Customer to excuse Rachel Green.
Rachel Green asks the Customer to give the coffee to another Customer across the room.
Rachel Green tells the Customer to go ahead and pass the coffee to the other Customer.
Rachel Green thanks the Customer for passing the coffee.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing is Liza Minelli in his Las Vegas dream.
